note: The one campaign rule set (PRD section 15). Read by the game (src/core/mission_rules.gd) and by the content build (tools/content). Four pads: 1 and 2 under the left thumb, 3 and 4 under the right. Drum voices: kick sound slot 1 on pad 1, slot 2 on pad 2; snare sound slot 1 on pad 4, slot 2 on pad 3. Bass voices: slot 1 pad 2, slot 2 pad 3, slot 3 pad 1, slot 4 pad 4.

hold.note: A hold released within this time of its tail counts as complete (full coverage). An earlier release ends its contribution: coverage = held time / hold length. It never fails the sequence by itself.

sequence.note: Credit per cue: a tap 1 when accepted, 0 when missed; a hold its coverage (1 when completed). A sequence succeeds when credit / cues >= threshold. Missions may set their own threshold.

precision.note: Precision = mean absolute onset error of the accepted cues plus stray_penalty_ms per stray press in the sequence divided by its cue count. Sharp <= sharp_ms, steady <= steady_ms, loose otherwise. The grade only sets the construction delay.

capacity.note: Rewarded buildings go to free prepared sockets. When every socket of every approach is taken, the reward repairs the most damaged defense of its approach; when nothing is damaged it reinforces the oldest defense (+50% health, once each). Rewarded units hold a defense point; at units_per_point the reward becomes a repair as well.
